Dari hasil penelusuran **Procurement Hub Agent** di dokumen PD, pemantauan dan pengelolaan Tingkat Komponen Dalam Negeri (TKDN) mencakup kegiatan monitoring, pelaporan, serta evaluasi yang diatur dalam *Peraturan Direksi* PD 004/2022 Pasal 12. 

Adapun ketentuan rinci terkait pemantauan dan pengelolaan TKDN meliputi:
- Pelaporan TKDN dilakukan secara periodik kepada Direksi Perseroan serta kepada instansi yang berwenang sesuai dengan tenggat waktu yang ditetapkan.
- Laporan kepada instansi berwenang dituangkan dalam format sesuai aturan yang berlaku dan disetujui oleh Direktur Utama atau pejabat lain yang ditunjuk.
- Perhitungan dan pelaporan TKDN dapat dibuat dan diintegrasikan dengan sistem ERP yang telah digunakan oleh Perseroan guna mendukung proses pengadaan dan penerimaan barang/jasa.
- Pelaksanaan *review* dan perbaikan proses dalam peningkatan TKDN Perseroan mencakup standardisasi kontraktual, registrasi *vendor*, pemutakhiran *supplier*, serta persyaratan dan sertifikasi Uji Coba Teknis & teknologi.
- Penerapan kewajiban denda atau sanksi diberlakukan atas realisasi TKDN pekerjaan *vendor* yang tidak sesuai dengan target atau komitmen.
- *Review* pencapaian implementasi TKDN dilakukan secara periodik agar dapat diusulkan target pencapaian TKDN untuk tahun berikutnya.
- Evaluasi pengelolaan penyedia Barang dan/atau Jasa dilakukan melalui edukasi, sosialisasi, verifikasi, dan audit *supplier* atas pencapaian TKDN.
- Perseroan mendorong *supplier* untuk bekerja sama dengan *vendor-vendor* dalam negeri serta mengusulkan kepada instansi berwenang (baik secara mandiri maupun melalui asosiasi pelaku industri telekomunikasi) untuk memberikan insentif kepada *supplier* melalui kebijakan yang berpihak pada implementasi TKDN.

Dari hasil penelusuran **Procurement Hub Agent** di dokumen *Peraturan Direksi*, pemantauan dan pengelolaan implementasi Tingkat Komponen Dalam Negeri (TKDN) mencakup kegiatan monitoring, pelaporan, dan evaluasi sebagaimana diatur dalam *PD 004/2022 Pasal 12*. Aktivitas tersebut meliputi:
- Pelaporan TKDN dilakukan secara periodik kepada Direksi Perseroan serta kepada instansi yang berwenang sesuai tenggat waktu (*PD 004/2022 Pasal 12 ayat (1) huruf a dan b*).
- Laporan TKDN kepada instansi berwenang dituangkan dalam format sesuai aturan berlaku yang disetujui oleh Direktur Utama atau pejabat lain yang ditunjuk (*PD 004/2022 Pasal 12 ayat (1) huruf c*).
- Perhitungan dan pelaporan TKDN dapat diintegrasikan dengan sistem ERP Perseroan guna mendukung proses pengadaan dan penerimaan barang/jasa (*PD 004/2022 Pasal 12 ayat (1) huruf d*).
- Pelaksanaan review dan perbaikan proses dalam peningkatan TKDN Perseroan, mencakup standardisasi kontraktual, registrasi vendor dan pemutakhiran supplier, serta persyaratan dan sertifikasi uji coba teknis & teknologi (*PD 004/2022 Pasal 12 ayat (1) huruf e*).
- Penerapan kewajiban denda atau sanksi atas realisasi TKDN pekerjaan vendor yang tidak sesuai dengan target atau komitmen (*PD 004/2022 Pasal 12 ayat (1) huruf f*).
- Pelaksanaan review pencapaian implementasi TKDN secara periodik untuk pengusulan target pencapaian tahun berikutnya (*PD 004/2022 Pasal 12 ayat (1) huruf g*).
- Pelaksanaan edukasi dan evaluasi pengelolaan penyedia barang/jasa, seperti sosialisasi, verifikasi, dan audit supplier atas pencapaian TKDN (*PD 004/2022 Pasal 12 ayat (2) huruf a*).
- Dorongan kepada supplier untuk bekerja sama dengan vendor-vendor dalam negeri (*PD 004/2022 Pasal 12 ayat (2) huruf b*).
- Pengusulan kepada instansi berwenang baik secara mandiri maupun melalui asosiasi pelaku industri telekomunikasi untuk memberikan insentif kepada supplier melalui kebijakan yang berpihak pada implementasi TKDN (*PD 004/2022 Pasal 12 ayat (2) huruf c*).

From **Procurement Hub Agent**'s review of the *Peraturan Direksi*, monitoring and managing *Tingkat Komponen Dalam Negeri* (*TKDN*) implementation involves several structured activities outlined in *PD 004/PD-00/2022 Pasal 11* and *Pasal 12*, which include periodic reporting, system integration, vendor management, and evaluations.

According to *PD 004/PD-00/2022 Pasal 12 ayat (1)*, monitoring and reporting activities consist of:
- Conducting periodic *TKDN* reporting to the Company's Board of Directors (*Direksi Perseroan*).
- Submitting *TKDN* reports to authorized institutions within the established deadlines, formatted according to applicable rules approved by the President Director or designated officials.
- Integrating *TKDN* calculations and reporting with the Company's ERP system to ensure procurement and goods/services receipt processes are unified.
- Reviewing and improving processes to increase *TKDN*, such as contractual standardization, vendor registration and supplier updates, and technical trial and technology certification requirements.
- Imposing fines or penalties for vendor work realizations that fail to meet *TKDN* targets or commitments.
- Conducting periodic reviews of *TKDN* implementation achievements to propose targets for the following year.

According to *PD 004/PD-00/2022 Pasal 12 ayat (2)*, evaluation activities consist of:
- Educating and evaluating goods and/or services providers through socialization, verification, and supplier audits regarding *TKDN* achievements.
- Encouraging suppliers to collaborate with domestic vendors.
- Proposing incentives for suppliers—either independently or through telecommunications industry associations—to authorized institutions through policies favoring *TKDN* implementation.

Additionally, *PD 004/PD-00/2022 Pasal 11* specifies that vendor management to support *TKDN* enhancement is carried out by:
- Enforcing registration and re-registration policies for new and existing vendors regarding device verification, adding information that supports the Company's *TKDN* increase.
- Providing continuous coaching to vendors regarding the enhancement of goods and/or services *TKDN* through document verification, socialization, site visits, and/or work audits.
- Providing feedback to vendors on the realization of *TKDN* achievements through awards or sanctions.
- Adjusting vendor management standardization in line with the Company's business direction and technology roadmap.

- *Demand Planning* can be used as baseline information to conduct *Category Management* activities (*Pasal 4 ayat (2) huruf a*).

Based on the documents *Procurement Hub Agent* can access, procurement contracts in the Company consist of several forms of contractual documents (*bentuk Perikatan*). According to *Peraturan Pengadaan* (*PR 016_2023* Pasal 18), the types of contractual documents issued are as follows:

- Master Purchase Agreement (MPA) or Kontrak Payung: Used to guarantee price certainty, quality, availability, delivery time, and terms and conditions within a specific timeframe, where the contract value remains an estimate and execution is followed by the issuance of a PO or non-PO according to the Company's needs (*PR 016_2023* Pasal 18 ayat (1) huruf a).
- Fixed Contract or Kontrak Induk: Used to guarantee price certainty, quantity, volume, quality, availability, delivery time, and terms and conditions for a specific timeframe based on mutual commitment, where execution can be followed by the issuance of a PO or non-PO according to the Company's needs (*PR 016_2023* Pasal 18 ayat (1) huruf b).
- Spot Contract or Kontrak Tunggal: An incidental procurement commitment containing the scope of work, type of goods and/or services, quantity, price or unit price, delivery, receipt, billing, and payment procedures, as well as the rights and obligations of both parties, where execution can be followed by the issuance of a PO or non-PO according to the Company's needs (*PR 016_2023* Pasal 18 ayat (1) huruf c).
- Purchase Order (PO): A realization of an MPA, Fixed Contract, or Spot Contract containing detailed information on the quantity, specifications of goods and/or services, delivery destination, receipt terms, and payment terms, serving as the basis for the *Supplier* to provide goods and/or services while other terms and conditions refer to the related contract (*PR 016_2023* Pasal 18 ayat (1) huruf d).

Please note that *PR 009_2025* amends Pasal 18 by redefining the Master Purchase Agreement, removing the Letter of Intent (LoI), and adding the Master Service Agreement (MSA).
